name: id
statement: id = Short 'n | Long 'm id

name: mk_id_def
statement:
mk_id [] n = Short n ∧
  mk_id (mn::mns) n = Long mn (mk_id mns n)

name: id_to_n_def
statement:
id_to_n (Short n) = n ∧
 id_to_n (Long _ id) = id_to_n id

name: id_to_mods_def
statement:
id_to_mods (Short _) = [] ∧
  id_to_mods (Long mn id) = mn::id_to_mods id

name: namespace
statement:
namespace =
    Bind (('n,'v) alist) (('m,namespace) alist)

name: nsLookup_def
statement:
nsLookup ((Bind v m):('m,'n,'v)namespace) (Short n) =
    ALOOKUP v n ∧
  nsLookup (Bind v m) (Long mn id) =
    case ALOOKUP m mn of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME env => nsLookup env id

name: nsLookupMod_def
statement:
nsLookupMod e [] = SOME (e:('m,'n,'v)namespace) ∧
  nsLookupMod (Bind v m) (mn::path) =
  case ALOOKUP m mn of NONE => NONE | SOME env => nsLookupMod env path

name: nsEmpty_def
statement: nsEmpty = Bind [] []

name: nsAppend_def
statement: nsAppend (Bind v1 m1) (Bind v2 m2) = Bind (v1 ++ v2) (m1 ++ m2)

name: nsLift_def
statement: nsLift mn env = Bind [] [(mn,env)]

name: alist_to_ns_def
statement: alist_to_ns a = Bind a []

name: nsBind_def
statement: nsBind k x (Bind v m) = Bind ((k,x)::v) m

name: nsBindList_def
statement: nsBindList l e = FOLDR (λ(x,v) e. nsBind x v e) e l

name: nsOptBind_def
statement: nsOptBind n x env = case n of NONE => env | SOME n => nsBind n x env

name: nsSing_def
statement: nsSing n x = Bind [(n,x)] []

name: nsSub_def
statement:
nsSub r env1 env2 ⇔
     (∀id v1.
        nsLookup env1 id = SOME v1 ⇒
        ∃v2. nsLookup env2 id = SOME v2 ∧ r id v1 v2) ∧
     ∀path. nsLookupMod env2 path = NONE ⇒ nsLookupMod env1 path = NONE

name: nsAll_def
statement: nsAll f env ⇔ ∀id v. nsLookup env id = SOME v ⇒ f id v

name: nsAll2_def
statement:
nsAll2 r env1 env2 ⇔
    nsSub r env1 env2 ∧ nsSub (λx y z. r x z y) env2 env1

name: nsDom_def
statement:
nsDom (env:('m,'n,'v)namespace) =
     {n | (v,n) | v ∈ 𝕌(:φ) ∧ n ∈ 𝕌(:(ν, ξ) id) ∧ nsLookup env n = SOME v}

name: nsDomMod_def
nsMap_def
statement:
nsMap (f:'v -> 'w) ((Bind v m):('m,'n,'v)namespace) =
    Bind (MAP (λ(n,x). (n,f x)) v) (MAP (λ(mn,e). (mn,nsMap f e)) m)
